text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Levi Pelepasan

(Kadar Levi Pelepasan) 2025.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Disember 2025.

Kadar levi pelepasan

2. Kadar levi pelepasan yang hendak dikenakan dan dilevikan atas mana-mana orang

yang meninggalkan Malaysia ditetapkan sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Perenggan 2]

KADAR LEVI PELEPASAN

(1)

Bil.

(2)

Negara

(3)

Kadar levi pelepasan

(3A)

Kelas ekonomi

(3B)

Selain kelas ekonomi

1. Negara ASEAN RM8.00 RM50.00

2. Selain Negara ASEAN RM20.00 RM150.00

2. Bagi maksud Jadual ini—

"kelas ekonomi" ertinya mana-mana kelas penerbangan yang diiklan, dijual dan

disediakan oleh syarikat penerbangan dalam kategori ekonomi atau kategori pakej

penerbangan terendah;

"Negara ASEAN" ertinya Brunei Darussalam, Kemboja, Republik Indonesia,

Republik Demokratik Rakyat Lao, Kesatuan Myanmar, Republik Filipina,

Republik Singapura, Thailand, Republik Sosialis Viet Nam dan Republik Demokratik

Timor-Leste.

Dibuat 28 November 2025

[SULIT KE.HD (122)860/23(2); MOF.700-2/1/16 Jld.17(S); PN(PU2)754]

DATUK SERI AMIR HAMZAH AZIZAN

Menteri Kewangan II

[Akan dibentangkan di hadapan Dewan Rakyat menurut subseksyen 11(2)

Akta Levi Pelepasan 2019]

DEPARTURE LEVY ACT 2019

DEPARTURE LEVY (RATE OF DEPARTURE LEVY) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 11(1) of the

Departure Levy Act 2019 [Act 813], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Departure Levy (Rate of Departure Levy)

Order 2025.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 December 2025.

Rate of departure levy

2. The rate of departure levy to be charged and levied on any person

who leaves Malaysia is fixed as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 2]

RATE OF DEPARTURE LEVY

(1)

No.

(2)

Country

(3)

Rate of departure levy

(3A)

Economy class

(3B)

Other than economy class

1. ASEAN Countries RM8.00 RM50.00

2. Other than ASEAN Countries RM20.00 RM150.00

2. For the purposes of this Schedule—

"economy class" means any class of flights advertised, sold and provided

by the airlines in the category of economy or category of the lowest airlines package;

"ASEAN Countries" means Brunei Darussalam, the Kingdom of Cambodia,

the Republic of Indonesia, the Lao People's Democratic Republic, the Union of Myanmar,

the Republic of Philippines, the Republic of Singapore, the Kingdom of Thailand,

the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam and the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste.

Made 28 November 2025

[SULIT KE.HD (122)860/23(2); MOF.700-2/1/16 Jld.17(S); PN(PU2)754]

DATUK SERI AMIR HAMZAH AZIZAN

Minister of Finance II

[To be laid before the Dewan Rakyat pursuant to subsection 11(2) of the

Departure Levy Act 2019]
